item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.71
item.description: Jobs on other Macs show the same step breakdown on your Mac. A failed job comes back to you to choose where to run it again (no automatic pass-on). The queue shows more or less as you drag it taller or shorter. Clear completed takes failed jobs off too. Boris FX subscriptions count as licensed. No flashing 'still exporting' note.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.70
item.description: Dragging a bin onto the window works again. Exports on Macs without ffmpeg (the Intel Mac) get it with this update and keep it across later updates.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.69
item.description: One Click Turnover (was Stem Splitter): the new name; Export on Other Macs (was Another Mac) comes with the app's licence - no add-on; a licence works on one Mac only (licences handed out before 26 Nov carry on working).

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.68
item.description: Warns when a timeline has unrendered effects whose plug-in isn't installed or isn't licensed on the Mac that exports it (Boris FX Continuum without a licence draws a big red X): in the queue's things to check, when you press Turnover, and next to each Mac in the shared queue.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.67
item.description: An × in the name and spoiler drop-downs takes one you don't want any more off the list. Also from 2.1.65-2.1.66: spoiler lines remembered, drag a bin onto the window on Intel Macs, export settings fitted to the Mac again.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.66
item.description: Spoiler lines are remembered: each spoiler box opens a list of the ones used before. Names are remembered as soon as they're typed. Also from 2.1.65: drag a bin onto the window on Intel Macs, export settings fitted to the Mac again.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.65
item.description: Fixes: a bin dragged onto the window opens on Intel Macs too; export settings are fitted to this Mac again (2.1.64 stopped that once a plan had reports ticked).

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.64
item.description: SS Reports in the turnover: tick Effects for the DI, ElevenLabs clips, Titles, Subtitles, Continuity or Music and each comes out as its own Excel file in a Reports folder. On _PIC in the SPLITS bin: an effect notes track for the DI (adjustment layers named), a scene numbers track and music markers. With Export off it says Split bin. Also the shared queue and Find the bad clip from 2.1.57-2.1.60.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.56
item.description: Turnover and Start queue check that Media Composer is open with a project before anything starts. The Accessibility button in Check my setup now fixes a switch left over from an earlier copy. The two-Mac watch folder is off in bought copies while it's tested.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.55
item.description: The two-Mac watch folder is switched off in bought copies while it's being tested.
